# Purpose
Defines the `FD_METRICS_EXEC` metric metadata table for the execution subsystem. The file includes `fd_metrics_exec.h` and initializes a constant array of `fd_metrics_meta_t` entries with `DECLARE_METRIC` for each execution metric. All listed metrics are `COUNTER` type values, including program cache misses, hits, fills, fill size total, fill failures, duplicate inserts, and invalidations. The file is generated by `gen_metrics.py` and must not be edited by hand.
